criteria.requirement: Implement simplejson.lines.iterloads(lines,*,errors="raise",use_decimal=False,max_chars=None), iterdumps(records), dump(records,stream) and frozen LineResult(line,status,value,error). Inputs are physical text/UTF-8 byte lines, optional BOM only on first line, blank lines ignored but counted. Validate options before consuming data. Reuse strict_loads duplicate/finite policy; collect returns a result per nonblank or invalid line and keeps later records, raise reports the physical line. Bound character size before parsing. Output uses stable_dumps, exactly one LF per record, validates each full record before its write, stays lazy and does not buffer all records. Detect short writes.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
